objective: Minimize cost and latency among protocols meeting preregistered human-graded accuracy, critical-defect and usefulness constraints. Do not let a weighted average compensate for blocking defects.

ordered_changes.change: Shared versioned transition policy for production and study with hash-bound prompts/schema/claims/report rules
ordered_changes.acceptance: Identical response tape, clock and budget observations produce matching stage/issue/stop trace.

ordered_changes.change: Immutable complete edit bundle resolves approved finding IDs to observations, regions, requirements, address/decline and preserve rules
ordered_changes.acceptance: Exact approved bundle is sent to editor and reviewers and linked to generated version; serialization cannot omit selected finding meaning.

ordered_changes.change: Server-owned prior-issue and locked-requirement regression matrix
ordered_changes.acceptance: Missing child disposition stays pending; two empty critics cannot clear parent blocker; quorum, regression completeness and quality remain separate.

ordered_changes.change: Shared normalized substantive-case/evidence fingerprints and development holdout overlap checks plus human cluster/provenance review
ordered_changes.acceptance: Title-only copies fail independent-case admission; semantic template variants retain cluster identities.

evaluation: Separate inexpensive invariant/trace/fault tests from actual provider plus independent human quality evaluation.
Freeze held-out cases, evidence, policy/prompts/model versions, randomization and analysis after development tuning.
Pair candidate vs strong single-provider baseline and independent proposals on same tasks/evidence; randomize execution within task-repeat blocks.
Ablate matched-compute single-provider resampling, independent providers, targeted versus broad critique, correction/re-audit and typed evidence resolution.
Keep all failed/missing/timeout primary outcomes; preserve unresolved exposure, adverse repeat defects and pre-adjudication grades.
Report paired absolute usefulness/defect differences with uncertainty, discordant cases, per-stratum outcomes, repeat stability and cost/latency attainment.
Use task/cluster-level resampling that keeps arms/repeats together; exact paired binary sensitivity analysis when small; preregister multiple comparisons and stopping.
Domain-competent humans grade blind before adjudication; double-review confirmatory primary cases when feasible and all suspected critical defects.
Visual policies use identical initial pixels within matched group; grade regressions, actual preference, cost and latency separately; user selection is not a quality label.

sample_size_illustration.assumptions: Independent representative Bernoulli cases, zero observed critical failures, fixed sample design
sample_size_illustration.caveat: Not a proposed release target or empirical result; same-case repeats cannot replace independent cases; domain gaps and clustered errors remain.

selection_rule: Preregister minimum useful benefit or noninferiority, critical-defect constraint, cost and latency bounds. Select a policy only when evidence meets them; otherwise retain simpler established policy and report inconclusive result.
tests_run: No existing suites rerun; only local exact mathematical calculation.
